verification.note: OBI:0600047 'sequencing assay' is the best parent class for a sequencing Level 1 schema node representing unaligned/unprocessed sequencing data. No ontology term exists specifically for 'Level 1 sequencing data'.
NCIT:C49189 'Primary Key' is defined as 'the attribute selected as being most important for uniquely identifying a body of information'. Matches the use as a unique row identifier / primary key.
OBI:0001618 'average depth of sequence coverage' directly matches the concept of sequencing coverage depth.

OBI:0002479 'sequence read length measurement datum' is defined as 'a measurement datum that is the result of the measurement of the number of bases in a DNA or RNA sequence', matching average read length.
No direct ontology term found for 'library selection method'. NCIT:C175894 is closest related NCIT term for library sequencing attributes. Partial match used as best available.

NCIT:C177618 'Library Sequencing' is defined as 'the method used to determine the order of purines and pyrimidines in a nucleic acid-based sequencing library'. Partial match — the strategy attribute describes assay type (e.g. RNA-Seq, ChIP-Seq), while this term describes the sequencing method applied to a library.
NCIT:C175895 'Sequencing Library Source Indicator' is defined as 'specifies the type of material that was the source of the nucleotide sequencing library'. Direct match.

NCIT:C175894 'Sequencing Library Read Layout Indicator' is defined as 'specifies what read strategy or method was used for sequencing and analysis of a nucleotide library'. Directly matches library layout (paired-end vs single).
NCIT:C182085 'Sequencing Library Preparation Kit Name' is defined as 'the name for the nucleotide sequencing library kit'. Exact match.

label: Sequencing Library Preparation Kit Vendor Name

verification.note: NCIT:C182086 'Sequencing Library Preparation Kit Vendor Name' is defined as 'the vendor name for the nucleotide sequencing library kit'. Exact match.
NCIT:C182087 'Sequencing Library Preparation Kit Version' is defined as 'the version for the nucleotide sequencing library kit'. Exact match.
NCIT:C172274 'Sequencing Platform Name' is defined as 'the name of the technology platform used to perform nucleic acid sequencing'. Direct match for sequencing platform/instrument.

term: NGS Library Preparation Days from Index
label: Number of Days Between Index Date and Specimen Collection

verification.note: NCIT:C181071 is the closest available term for 'days from index' concepts. No specific term found for library preparation days from index; this term describes days from index to specimen collection rather than library preparation.
No specific OLS term found for 'raw reads count'. OBI:0600047 is the closest parent concept. Row noted as partial match only.
NCIT:C175895 'Sequencing Library Source Indicator' covers source material type; no term specifically for 'source molecule' (DNA/RNA/cDNA distinction). Partial match.
